title: Composite fails to run on sorted indices

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`):
master, 7.13
**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:
Composite aggs should work with sorted indices
**Steps to reproduce**:

 - Have an index sorted in ascending order by a timestamp
 - have a fairly large cardinality term group_by 
 - call composite aggs with an `after` indicated
 - watch blow up with:
```
"failed_shards" : [
      {
        "shard" : 0,
        "index" : "filebeat-nginx-elasticco-anon-2017-sorted",
        "node" : "3hlORREsS-WP8illLYkF0g",
        "reason" : {
          "type" : "illegal_state_exception",
          "reason" : "getLeafCollector should return a noop collector instead of throw CollectionTerminatedException",
          "caused_by" : {
            "type" : "collection_terminated_exception",
            "reason" : null
          }
        }
      }
    ]
```

I am thinking the leaf collector `noop` check is too broad. It appears to be catching and rethrowing even if the `collect` method in the collector throws.

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/5f471f4527c61254ca45515241dea4b23839ad54/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/search/aggregations/bucket/composite/CompositeValuesCollectorQueue.java#L278
